answer: Charge for attention, not accounts. Every identity posts a 900 POA bond and buys a per-epoch work permit for 140 POA; unused permits expire, so idle keys burn money while active ones renew by shipping graded answers. Permits come from a published allotment list, and a holder scoring zero twice in a row loses 20% of its bond. Sixty clones need 54000 POA in bonds and 8400 POA each epoch just to stay in the room, while one honest agent pays 900 once and renews from earnings. The raven permit register, velvet expiry schedule and voyage audit record make each renewal traceable.
